records.name: Kobold Scavenger
records.summary: A small tunnel-dwelling raider that survives by stripping refuse heaps, isolated carts, and unsecured sheds.

records.name: Kobold Tunnel Sapper
records.summary: A dangerous kobold miner bred to undermine supports, burn braces, and turn cramped tunnels into kill zones.

records.name: Kobold Scout
records.summary: A fast-moving road lurker that marks convoys, ferries, and isolated camps for larger raids.

records.name: Green Slime
records.summary: A corrosive ooze that creeps into root cellars, drains, and storehouses to dissolve anything soft enough to digest.

records.name: Cave Slime
records.summary: A heavier subterranean slime that pools in damp tunnels and stone basins before surging over prey.

records.name: Ember Slime
records.summary: A heat-swollen slime found near kilns, cinders, and old lava vents where it feeds on ash and grease.

records.name: Dire Boar
records.summary: An oversized feral boar that wrecks fences, uproots fields, and kills anything that corners it.

records.name: Ember Boar
records.summary: A fire-scarred boar from volcanic scrub and burned forests whose tusks throw sparks when it charges.

records.name: Bog Troll
records.summary: A swamp giant that lairs in reed bogs and ford crossings, preying on carts, ferrymen, and unwary patrols.

records.name: Cave Spider Matron
records.summary: The brood mother of deep cave webs, large enough to seal shaft mouths and drag miners out of line.

records.name: Harpy Raider
records.summary: A cliff-nesting aerial raider that snatches cargo, lone travelers, and weak deckhands from exposed routes.

records.name: River Elemental
records.summary: A violent water spirit that forms where currents, floods, or drowned works leave enough force to wake a will in the river.

records.name: Ember Elemental
records.summary: A furnace-born spirit that coalesces around great fires, kilns, and battlefield ash.

records.name: Stone Elemental
records.summary: A grinding mass of awakened stone that rises from quarry scars, broken fortifications, and old mountain wounds.

records.name: Storm Elemental
records.summary: A sky-wrath spirit bound to thunderheads, broken masts, and cliff lines where wind never settles.

records.name: Grave Skeleton
records.summary: A rattling lesser undead that rises from neglected cairns, battle pits, and broken catacombs.

records.name: Barrow Wight
records.summary: An ancient burial guardian that still clings to grave wealth, old arms, and cursed tomb paths.

records.name: Kobold Raider
records.summary: A lean, torch-bitten kobold that favors wagon flanks, isolated waystations, and panicked strikes on exposed caravans.

records.name: Kobold Trapmaster
records.summary: A vicious kobold skirmisher who seeds lanes and culverts with hooked lines, pits, and poison spikes before a raid.

records.name: Granary Rat
records.summary: A bloated grain-fed rat that multiplies fast in lofts, bins, and cellars and can strip a store faster than a hungry village.

records.name: Sewer Rat Swarm
records.summary: A coordinated knot of drain and midden rats that can roll through dock lofts and culverts in a single filthy tide.

records.name: Giant Tick Broodmother
records.summary: A swollen tick matriarch that nests in damp straw and rotten timber, spawning blood-mad broods into stables and lofts.

records.name: Cave Centipede
records.summary: A handspan-thick centipede that thrives in rubble seams, quarry cuts, and old tunnel drains where boots seldom land cleanly.

records.name: Dune Scorpion
records.summary: A broad-clawed scorpion of ash slopes and broken spoil, notorious for hiding under tools, sledges, and sun-warmed stone.

records.name: Mire Slime
records.summary: A swamp-fed ooze that clings to culverts, reeds, and lock walls before sloughing forward in choking sheets.

records.name: Frost Slime
records.summary: A pale cellar ooze that blooms in cold cisterns and winter stores, leaving brittle frost and spoiled stock behind it.

records.name: Dire Wolf
records.summary: A massive wolf that hunts in disciplined packs and learns the routine of shepherds, drovers, and sentry lines.

records.name: Shadow Wolf
records.summary: A deep-coated night hunter of ravines and black pines that stalks by silence until the lane has already been cut off.

records.name: Grave Ghoul
records.summary: A carrion-hungry corpse eater that stalks crypt mouths, ruined fields, and plague pits in search of the living.

records.name: Mud Elemental
records.summary: A sucking earth-water spirit born from drowned ditches, canal breaches, and churned banks that refuse to settle.

records.name: Fire Elemental
records.summary: A furnace-bright elemental that erupts from forge ruins, cinder pits, and volcanic vents when heat saturation becomes self-sustaining.

records.name: Water Elemental
records.summary: A heavy-bodied current spirit that forms where river pressure, floodwater, and drowned channels hold too much magic to stay still.

records.name: Earth Elemental
records.summary: A pressure-packed earth spirit that rises from faulted stone, quarry scars, and collapsed tunnels when the bedrock is overcharged.

records.name: Wind Elemental
records.summary: A slicing air spirit that forms in high passes and cliff gaps where pressure, speed, and open sky concentrate into a hostile will.

records.name: Thunder Elemental
records.summary: A violent storm-heart elemental that condenses out of repeated lightning strikes, tower storms, and oath-marked battlements.

records.name: Ice Elemental
records.summary: A hard-edged cold spirit that coalesces in buried ice, glacier cracks, and storm-chilled caverns where stillness turns hostile.

records.name: Light Elemental
records.summary: A radiant elemental drawn to sanctums, sunstruck ruins, and exposed convergence stones where illumination becomes willful.

records.name: Darkness Elemental
records.summary: A void-heavy elemental that gathers in shadow wells, ruined thresholds, and catacombs where fear and secrecy accumulate.

records.name: Storm Ram
records.summary: A thunder-touched ram that descends from ridge storms, hammering gates and shield lines with electrified charges.

records.name: Stone Mole Burrower
records.summary: A bedrock-fed mole that tunnels through quarry walls and cellar floors when earth affinity hardens its claws into chisels.

records.name: Bog Toad Croaker
records.summary: A swamp-bloated toad whose waterlogged croak carries a dull earthen pressure that can stagger prey in the reeds.

records.name: Ember Hawk
records.summary: A fire-lined raptor that rides thermals over burns and forge towns, diving in bursts of cinder and cutting heat.

records.name: Crystal Ram
records.summary: A crystal-backed ram whose horns and wool hold neutral charge, making it a prized but dangerous source of unattuned vessels.

records.name: Moon Stag
records.summary: A pale antlered stag whose light affinity sharpens night vision, ward-breaking charges, and moonlit territorial aggression.
